Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Data Science

What is Data Science?

Data Science is the practice of extracting meaningful insights from data using statistics, machine learning, and analytics. It helps businesses understand patterns, predict trends, and make data-driven decisions that improve performance and profitability.

What data do you need from us?

We need access to your business data - sales records, customer information, transaction logs, website analytics, etc. The specific data depends on your goals. We'll guide you through exactly what's needed during our discovery phase and ensure all data is handled securely.

How long does it take to see results?

Initial insights can be delivered within 10-15 days for basic analytics. Comprehensive dashboards take 20-30 days. Advanced predictive models may take 45-60 days. You'll start seeing value from the first week as we deliver incremental results.

Do I need technical knowledge?

No! We design user-friendly dashboards that anyone can use. You'll get training on how to interpret the data and use the tools. Our visualizations are intuitive and designed for business users, not data scientists.

Can you work with my existing data?

Yes! We work with data from any source - Excel files, databases, CRM systems, accounting software, website analytics, social media, and more. We'll integrate everything into a unified analytics platform.

What's the difference between Analytics and Data Science?

Analytics focuses on understanding what happened and why (descriptive). Data Science goes further to predict what will happen and prescribe actions (predictive and prescriptive). We offer both based on your needs and maturity level.
